name: app-ai-scam-protection-long-feature-and-persona-sheet
title: Scam Protection Features and Persona Sheet
whatItIs: A tall pale sheet with an AI Security heading, a hero tile of a phone between chrome brackets over blue ribbons, two feature tiles for call and message protection, a persona block with goals, pain points and priorities, and a closing section of call screens with captions.
whatItMeans: Alternating hero renders, feature tiles and a persona block build a complete story in a calm pastel system.
techniques: Hero tile with chrome props and blue ribbons
Feature tiles with device and short caption
Persona portrait beside coloured goal and pain cards
Zoomed component beside the full screen
Consistent pastel colour-coded call and message rows
bestFor: AI and security app case studies

vocabulary.definition: A tile explaining one feature with a device and caption.
A section showing a user's goals and pain points.
Pills using green, red and yellow to show safe, scam and risky.
